title: heleniastrum
intro: Heleniastrum, commonly known as Helichrysum, is a genus of flowering plants in the daisy family, Asteraceae. This plant is renowned for its numerous health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which can aid in wound healing, reduce fever, and alleviate respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Helichrysum are attributed to its ability to soothe and calm the nervous system, promoting relaxation and reducing anxiety. The bioactive constituents of Helichrysum include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and are responsible for its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant activities.
